The question is no longer whether Prabowo can fulfill his political ambitions, but whether Indonesians can afford the costs of pursuing them.

items.summary: In an inspiring project, eighth-grader Locklyn Raye Ward from Oklahoma explored the antibacterial capabilities of wild plants. Analyzing 24 plants sourced from her family’s farm, she found that 56 percent demonstrated antibacterial effects, but none were as potent as commercial antibiotics. Interestingly, seven native plants showcased promising antibiotic properties, prompting Locklyn to highlight the importance of wild plants while addressing the significant issue of antibiotic overuse.

items.summary: President Lee Jae Myung renewed his call Saturday for a review of multicultural family support programs, saying any preferential policy that can create reverse discrimination cannot be justified. Lee posted the comments on social media amid criticism after he suggested the need to revise the support programs for multicultural families in South Korea, such as priority access to low-cost public postpartum care centers. In an earlier posting on his X account, Lee questioned whether mothers from multicultural families and mothers recognized as persons of national merit deserve to be placed in the same category for reservations at government-funded postpartum care centers. The issue, which the liberal president brought forward after citing a post from a conservative online community site, has drawn backlash from the liberal bloc voicing concern that such a move amounts to inciting hatred in society. "While it is true that support for multicultural families is necessary, that cannot justify specific policies that are unreasonable or may result in reverse discrimination," Lee wrote on X. "Just b

items.title: In super-aged Korea, social isolation leaves seniors searching for connection
items.title_zh: 在超级老龄化的韩国，社交孤立让老年人寻找联系
items.summary: Tucked away near the rear entrance of Seoul Station is a building bustling with older adults coming and going. Inside, dozens of white-haired visitors fill the space, some drinking cheap coffee while others watch television. Farther inside, two barbers cut the hair of older visitors. A narrow staircase leads down to a basement, where a small PC cafe with a row of computers and tables for "baduk" (go) and "janggi" (Korean chess) is located. Nearly every seat is occupied by an older person. “The door is always open and we don’t ask them to do anything, including pray,” said Woo Yeon-shik, a pastor who runs the center, Dream City, which also doubles as a church. Operating near Seoul Station since 2011, Dream City draws more than 300 older people each day from across the capital. For Woo, the space increasingly serves a purpose that goes beyond its original mission of helping homeless people: giving older people somewhere to go and someone to be around. That role has become more urgent as Korea, one of the world’s fastest-aging societies, grapples with high suicide rates and social i

items.title: Fishing boat catches fire off west coast, all 22 rescued
items.title_zh: 渔船在西海岸起火， 22人全部获救
items.summary: INCHEON — A fishing boat caught fire off the West Sea island of Yeongheung on Saturday and all 22 people aboard were rescued, with two of them taken to a hospital for inhaling smoke, officials said. The fire broke out on the 9.77-ton charter fishing boat in waters 0.9 nautical mile south of the island at 6:51 a.m. After receiving a distress call from the boat, the Coast Guard sent patrol and rescue boats to the scene, put out the fire and rescued all aboard. Two of them, including the boat's skipper, were taken to a hospital for inhaling smoke. Two Coast Guard officers also inhaled smoke and planned to receive medical treatment. The Coast Guard plans to investigate the exact cause of the fire and the extent of damage based on witness statements that sparks and smoke came from the boat's passenger cabin.

items.title: No drug-related violations found in special crackdown on eve of Halloween
items.title_zh: 在万圣节前夕的特别镇压中没有发现与毒品有关的违规行为
items.summary: Police said Saturday they have found no drug-related violations during a joint crackdown the previous night on nightlife districts in Seoul on the eve of Halloween. Police carried out inspections at eight clubs in nightlife districts in Gangnam, Seocho and Yongsan on Friday night as part of a special drug crackdown that has been under way since August in cooperation with fire and municipality authorities. "Ahead of Halloween, we conducted crackdowns focusing on clubs, entertainment venues, and areas with high concentrations of foreigners, where large crowds are expected," a police official said. "We will continue to strengthen inspections and crackdown activities in vulnerable areas." Police urged the public to actively report drug-related crimes, saying they will guarantee the anonymity of informants and rewards will be provided.

items.title: Ruling party lawmaker issued US visa, days after refusal

items.summary: Rep. Jin Sung-joon of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea said Saturday he has been issued a U.S. visa for a trip to the U.S. Pacific Command, days after he said his application was rejected. Jin, who serves as chairman of the parliamentary defense committee, said in a Facebook post that he received the visa from the U.S. Embassy in Seoul and that it was fortunate the U.S. State Department has issued the official A-2 visa, albeit belatedly. The lawmaker said he will depart Sunday afternoon and hold discussions with the U.S Pacific commander and other U.S. military leaders about strengthening bilateral security cooperation and developing a future-oriented alliance. On Wednesday, Jin had said his U.S. visa application was rejected and shared on Facebook what appeared to be a document that showed his application was refused. Jin expressed strong regret, saying the rejection was difficult to understand, given that he had visited the U.S. command in 2014 as a member of the parliamentary committee. items.title: Once shunned, prisons become sought-after facilities for local communities
items.title_zh: 监狱一旦被避开，就会成为当地社区的热门设施
items.summary: Prisons, once widely regarded as undesirable facilities, are now drawing competition from local governments seeking to revive shrinking communities and struggling economies. Seven municipal governments are competing to host four new correctional facilities as part of the Ministry of Justice’s first nationwide competitive bidding process for prison sites. The ministry launched a nationwide call for applications on Aug. 28, marking the first time it has used a competitive bidding process to select sites for new correctional facilities. Previously, sites were chosen through consultations between the ministry and local governments. Under the new system, municipalities must seek residents' input and obtain approval from their local councils before submitting bids. The four planned facilities will each have a capacity of 1,000 inmates and employ around 250 staff members. items.title: Korea expands benefits for retired working dogs to help them find forever homes
items.title_zh: 韩国扩大退休工作犬的福利，帮助他们找到永久住所
items.summary: Korea is stepping up its efforts to help retired working dogs find forever homes by building a comprehensive, state-funded safety net designed to ease the steep financial burden on adoptive families. Under an expanded initiative led by the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, the government is introducing direct medical subsidies, discounted veterinary care, and dedicated hospice facilities to ensure these canine public servants are cared for after their service ends. Roughly 1,100 working dogs currently serve across six government bodies, including the military, police, fire services, customs and quarantine inspection. Among them, the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency alone operates approximately 70 specialized detector dogs at key international travel hubs. For years, private adoption for retired working dogs faced steep hurdles. Specialized breeds like beagles, Labradors, and Malinois typically retire around age 8 after six to eight years of active duty. Upon retirement, adoptive owners are left with high medical costs for joint issues, dental problems and chronic ailment

items.title: 'Assume everything is being recorded': Korea's Gen Z rewrites the rules of office life
items.title_zh: “假设一切都被记录下来” ：韩国的Z世代改写了办公室生活的规则
items.summary: "Whenever you talk to an employee in their 20s, it's probably best to assume the entire conversation is being recorded." It is a warning increasingly shared among Korean managers in their 40s and 50s as they try to make sense of a generation of young employees whose workplace habits can seem baffling — and sometimes unsettling — to their bosses. Some older managers see low loyalty to the company and a lack of respect for senior colleagues. Gen Z workers, however, see something very different: a desire for clear communication, boundaries between work and private life and relationships based less on hierarchy. From recording conversations with bosses and avoiding unnecessary apologies to skipping team lunches and continuing to use honorific speech even with close colleagues, young Koreans are quietly rewriting some of the unwritten rules that have long governed the country's offices. Why record a conversation with your boss? For some middle managers, discovering that a young employee is recording a conversation without saying anything can be uncomfortable. items.title: Is it really just the autumn blues?
items.title_zh: 真的只是秋天的蓝调吗？
items.summary: "I think the fall is getting to me." That's what a friend told me on the phone recently. "You're middle-aged now, and suddenly you're getting the autumn blues?" I said jokingly. He laughed awkwardly, then began telling me about his life lately. Seeing the darkening sky on his way home from work drains his energy. Once home, he lies on the couch and does nothing. Even after sleeping in on weekends, he doesn't feel refreshed. And after dinner, he finds himself reaching for bread and snacks. As I listened, I began to wonder whether it was really something that could simply be blamed on the season. In Korea, the expression "gaeul tada," literally "to be affected by autumn," carries a certain romanticism. It describes that wistful feeling that arrives with falling leaves, when even a familiar song can unexpectedly stir the emotions. But persistent sadness and lethargy, along with losing interest in hobbies once enjoyed, are a long way from romantic autumn melancholy. items.title: Saudi foreign minister discusses regional security with Russian, Canadian and EU officials
items.title_zh: 沙特外长与俄罗斯、加拿大和欧盟官员讨论地区安全问题
items.summary: ATLANTA — Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan held separate meetings with his counterparts from Russia and Canada, as well as the European Union's foreign policy chief, on the sidelines of the G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Atlanta.During his meeting with Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov, Prince Faisal reviewed bilateral relations and discussed major regional developments, particularly the escalation in Yemen and continuing threats to maritime navigation through the Strait of Hormuz and Bab Al-Mandab Strait.The two ministers also explored efforts to enhance regional security and promote stability.In a separate meeting Friday, Prince Faisal met Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand to discuss bilateral relations and the latest developments in the region.Both sides condemned the Houthi militia's continued attacks against Saudi Arabia and emphasized the importance of efforts to achieve regional security and stability.Prince Faisal also met Kaja Kallas, the European Union's high representative for foreign affairs and security policy and vice president of the European Commission.Their discussions focused on regional and international developments, with both sides reaffirming the importance of maintaining security and stability in the region.

items.title: Air defenses intercept Houthi missiles, drones targeting Makkah, Madinah and other regions

items.summary: RIYADH — Air defenses intercepted and destroyed two missiles and three drones launched by the Houthi militia toward several regions of the Kingdom on Friday and Saturday, according to the Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen.Coalition spokesperson Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki said air defense forces intercepted and destroyed a cruise missile launched by the Houthi militia toward the western region and a ballistic missile targeting the southern region.Al-Maliki added that three drones launched by the Houthis toward Riyadh, Makkah and Madinah were also intercepted and destroyed.The latest interceptions followed similar incidents Thursday, when Saudi air defenses intercepted and destroyed two ballistic missiles launched by the Houthis toward Riyadh and another ballistic missile targeting the Eastern Province, according to Al-Maliki.Meanwhile, Saudi Civil Defense urged citizens and residents to follow safety instructions during warning periods, including staying away from open areas and glass windows and avoiding balconies and rooftops.

items.title: Saudi Arabia, US sign official participation agreement for Expo 2030 Riyadh

items.title: Saudi Arabia offers condolences to Italy over military helicopter crash in Bosnia and Herzegovina
items.title_zh: 沙特阿拉伯向意大利军用直升机在波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那坠毁表示哀悼
items.summary: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia has expressed its sincere condolences and sympathy to the families of those killed, as well as to the government and people of Italy, following the crash of a military helicopter in Bosnia and Herzegovina during a joint training operation involving European Union forces.In a statement, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs expressed the Kingdom's solidarity with the families of the victims and those injured, as well as with the government and people of Italy.The ministry also wished the injured a speedy recovery and expressed hope for the safety and well-being of all.

items.title: Saudi, US foreign ministers discuss Iran, Sudan and Yemen on sidelines of G20 meeting
items.title_zh: 沙特、美国外长在G20会议期间讨论伊朗、苏丹和也门问题
items.summary: ATLANTA — Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan met with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Friday on the sidelines of the G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Atlanta, United States.The meeting focused on the strategic relationship between Saudi Arabia and the United States and ways to strengthen bilateral cooperation in priority areas.The two ministers also exchanged views on current regional developments and ongoing efforts to address challenges facing the Middle East.Rubio highlighted discussions on Iran, Sudan and Yemen as key areas of cooperation between Riyadh and Washington."It was great to meet with Saudi Foreign Minister @FaisalbinFarhan in Atlanta," Rubio said in a statement."We discussed ways our countries can continue working together on regional challenges, including the situations in Iran, Sudan, and Yemen," he added.

items.title: Boulevard World opens for Riyadh Season 2026 with global cultural experiences
items.title_zh: Boulevard World在2026年利雅得季开幕，提供全球文化体验
items.summary: RIYADH — Boulevard World opened its doors to visitors on Friday as part of the seventh edition of Riyadh Season, bringing together international cultures, entertainment attractions and family experiences in one destination.Returning for its fifth consecutive year, Boulevard World offers visitors an opportunity to explore cultures and civilizations through themed zones inspired by countries around the world.The destination features architecture, traditional markets, restaurants, handicrafts and live performances reflecting the cultural identities of participating countries.Visitors can explore zones representing Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Türkiye, Iran, Japan, China, France, Italy, Morocco, Greece, Mexico, Egypt, the United States, India, South Korea, Indonesia and Spain, alongside areas inspired by African, Asian and Levantine cultures.Each destination features restaurants, retail outlets and live entertainment, allowing visitors to experience international cuisines, shopping and cultural performances.Boulevard World also offers a range of entertainment attractions for visitors of all ages, including the Amazonia Awakens water ride, Vuz Dome cinema with its immersive 360-degree screenings, and BLVD Pier amusement rides.Other attractions include a cable car offering aerial views of the destination, adventure experiences, interactive games and racing activities.The lake remains one of Boulevard World's major attractions, offering water taxis and various boating experiences.The Africa zone also features opportunities to observe and interact with animals, while dedicated play areas and family activities provide entertainment for children.Since its launch in 2022, Boulevard World has established itself as one of Riyadh Season's prominent entertainment destinations, attracting visitors from Saudi Arabia and abroad.Tickets for Boulevard World are available through the Webook platform, where visitors can explore admission options and book experiences offered as part of Riyadh Season 2026.

items.title: Civil Defense warns of heavy thunderstorms, flash floods across Kingdom until Wednesday
items.title_zh: 民防部门警告说，直到周三，整个王国都会有大雷暴和山洪暴发
items.summary: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia's General Directorate of Civil Defense has urged the public to exercise caution as thunderstorms and heavy rainfall are expected to continue across most regions of the Kingdom until Wednesday.The directorate called on residents to remain in safe locations, avoid valleys and areas prone to flash flooding, and refrain from swimming in floodwaters.It also stressed the importance of following official safety instructions issued through media outlets and social media platforms.According to forecasts from the National Center for Meteorology (NCM), moderate to heavy rainfall is expected in parts of the Makkah region, including Taif, Adham, Maysan and Al-Ardiyat.The rainfall could trigger flash floods, hailstorms and strong downdraft winds that stir up dust and sand.Light to moderate rainfall is also forecast in Makkah city, Al-Kamil, Al-Jumum, Al-Qunfudhah and Al-Lith.The regions of Jazan, Asir and Al-Baha are expected to experience moderate to heavy thunderstorms, accompanied by flash floods, hail and dust-raising winds.Meanwhile, light to moderate rainfall is forecast across Madinah, Hail, Al-Jouf, the Northern Borders, Tabuk and the Eastern Province.Civil Defense reiterated its call for the public to take necessary precautions and comply with official warnings to ensure their safety during the period of unstable weather.

items.title: HRDF to raise minimum salary eligible for employment support to SR6,000 by 2028
items.title_zh: HRDF到2028年将有资格获得就业支持的最低工资提高到6,000里亚尔
items.summary: RIYADH — The Human Resources Development Fund (HRDF) announced that it will raise the minimum monthly salary eligible for its Employment Support Program from SR4,000 to SR5,000 starting April 25, 2027, and to SR6,000 starting April 25, 2028.The increase will be implemented in two phases, in line with the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development's decision to raise the minimum salary required for Saudi employees to be counted under the Nitaqat Saudization program.Under the first phase, the minimum eligible salary for new employment support applications will increase from SR4,000 to SR5,000 on April 25, 2027. The revised threshold will apply to existing support applications beginning with payments for May 2027.The second phase will take effect on April 25, 2028, when the minimum eligible salary for new applications will increase from SR5,000 to SR6,000. Existing applications will be subject to the revised threshold beginning with payments for May 2028.HRDF confirmed that it will continue subsidizing up to 50% of eligible Saudi employees' monthly salaries, with a maximum contribution of SR3,000 per month, subject to the program's approved terms and conditions.The fund said the changes are intended to strengthen the competitiveness of Saudi workers, improve job quality and sustainability, and encourage private sector establishments to recruit Saudi talent.The Employment Support Program helps private sector employers hire Saudi men and women by covering part of their salaries, supporting job creation and employment stability.HRDF said the adjustments reflect its continued efforts to enhance the participation of Saudi nationals in the labor market and support the Kingdom's economic development objectives.

items.title: Saudi Arabia suspends travel to Kenya, bans arrivals over Ebola outbreak risks
items.title_zh: 沙特阿拉伯暂停前往肯尼亚的旅行，因埃博拉疫情风险禁止入境
items.summary: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia has introduced additional precautionary measures to limit the risks associated with the Ebola virus outbreak, including suspending travel by Saudi citizens to Kenya, halting the issuance of all types of visas to travelers from the country and banning their entry into the Kingdom.The measures, adopted following an assessment of the epidemiological situation by the relevant health authorities, also prohibit entry by travelers arriving through third countries who have stayed in Kenya or other countries affected by Ebola outbreaks during the 21 days preceding their arrival in Saudi Arabia.The new restrictions build on preventive measures first introduced by the Kingdom in July 2019 and strengthened in May 2026 for travelers arriving from countries facing Ebola outbreak risks.Saudi authorities said the measures reflect a proactive approach based on continuous health risk monitoring and assessment, alongside coordination with relevant domestic and international authorities to protect citizens, residents and visitors.In June 2026, Saudi Arabia suspended travel by its citizens to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda and South Sudan, as well as arrivals from those countries.The Kingdom also strengthened precautionary measures for travelers arriving from countries neighboring Ebola-affected areas, including screening at entry points, epidemiological investigations and early health response mechanisms.The Saudi Public Health Authority (Weqaya) reassured the public that the Kingdom's health situation remains stable and is subject to close and continuous monitoring.Weqaya said it continues to track epidemiological developments regionally and internationally in coordination with relevant authorities inside and outside Saudi Arabia.The authority emphasized that additional preventive measures would be taken as necessary in response to changes in the epidemiological situation, ensuring the Kingdom's health preparedness and protecting public health and safety.

items.title: Saudi Foreign Minister arrives in Atlanta for G20 talks on global security, economy
items.title_zh: 沙特外长抵达亚特兰大就全球安全、经济问题举行G20会谈
items.summary: RIYADH — Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan arrived in Atlanta, United States, on Friday to participate in the G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting.The meeting will address major geopolitical developments, maritime security, energy, food security, global trade and supply chains.Discussions will also focus on strengthening international cooperation and multilateral action to address global economic challenges.The Saudi delegation accompanying Prince Faisal includes Saudi Ambassador to the United States Princess Reema bint Bandar and Deputy Minister of Finance Abdulmohsen Al-Khalaf, who serves as Saudi Arabia's G20 sherpa.
